title: tbl-md configuration
description: The configuration file .tbl-md.json of tbl-md, for lint and convert.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema. tbl-md ignores the value.

attributeKeys.description: The attribute keys of the project. tbl-md lint warns on each other key. The key align is always known.

flavor.description: The target renderer of GFM, for tbl-md lint and tbl-md convert. The flag --flavor overrides it. The default is discourse.
